body.x: CHOISTECHNOLOGY Co., Ltd. (CEO Soonpil Choi) participated in CES 2026, the world’s largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition, held in Las Vegas, the United States, from January 6 to 9 (local time).

Founded in 2001, CHOISTECHNOLOGY is a specialized company in the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) field and has secured proprietary technologies and numerous domestic and international patents in core body temperature algorithms, wearable sensors, and wireless communication technologies. The company has also accumulated extensive clinical development experience through collaborations with major university hospitals and, based on this foundation, has developed and supplied high-precision, high-reliability, data–driven medical solutions, according to the company.

In particular, CHOISTECHNOLOGY presents continuous body temperature monitoring solutions that connect hospitals, public health environments, and homes, aiming to establish next-generation digital healthcare standards by expanding domestic and international certifications and joint development partnerships.

At CES 2026, CHOISTECHNOLOGY showcased its flagship product, “Thermosafer XST600.” This is a wireless temperature monitoring solution that continuously and non-invasively measures a patient’s core body temperature from the skin surface, offering a differentiated approach by enabling continuous tracking of temperature trends with a more convenient usage method than conventional intermittent temperature measurements or invasive catheter-based thermometers.

Thermosafer XST600 collects clinically meaningful core body temperature data using a heat-flux–based algorithm. It can operate stably in medical environments that require precise temperature management, such as operating rooms and intensive care units, and it strengthens stability and convenience through Bluetooth wireless communication and optimized signal characteristics.

In addition, the solution supports integration with patient monitoring devices and hospital systems such as EMR, enabling real-time aggregation of temperature data. This allows medical staff to check patient temperature information without additional procedures, improving workflow efficiency. The device also features a structure that separates the main unit from the sensor and uses a magnetic disposable probe, which benefits infection control while simultaneously reducing consumable costs and maintenance burdens.

With these comprehensive strengths, Thermosafer XST600 earned a CES 2026 Innovation Award, validating the product’s technological maturity and scalability. Company representatives emphasized that the product also attracted strong interest from potential buyers and partners at the exhibition site.

CHOISTECHNOLOGY stated, “As we prepare for FDA approval of Thermosafer XST600, we are pleased to have had the opportunity at CES 2026 to introduce our product, company, and technological competitiveness to customers in North America.”

The company added, “Starting from this CES, we will pursue phased market expansion in the United States, the world’s largest healthcare market, positioning the product for broad application across telemedicine, digital health, and B2C healthcare sectors.” It continued, “We also plan to accelerate preparations for entry into the Middle East, where government-led healthcare infrastructure investment and smart hospital development are actively underway.”

body.x: The Incheon Metropolitan City Government and the Incheon Free Economic Zone Authority formed the “INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion” at LVCC North Hall during CES 2026, presenting Incheon’s urban vision and innovative technologies as it evolves beyond a smart city into the AI era. By linking various exhibition programs, including Eureka Park, global pavilions, and the CES Innovation Awards Showcase, the pavilion supported the participation of 51 Incheon-based innovative companies at CES, including 10 companies exhibiting at the INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion. In particular, 14 companies won 17 CES Innovation Awards, marking the largest achievement to date and demonstrating the technological competitiveness and global growth potential of Incheon’s innovative enterprises.
